title: crepidiastrum koshunense
intro: Crepidiastrum koshunense, commonly known as Japanese milk vetch or Japanese winter vetch, is a plant species in the legume family native to East Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, particularly in Japan and China, for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Crepidiastrum koshunense include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and treating respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
